meta.en: Era: Active in the 1920s; first Imam of the Chigato Mosque from 1924 (birth and death dates unknown)
meta.sw: Kipindi: Alikuwa hai katika miaka ya 1920; Imamu wa kwanza wa Msikiti wa Chigato kuanzia 1924 (tarehe za kuzaliwa na kufariki hazijulikani)
meta.dg: Wakati: Wahenda kaziye miaka ya 1920; Imamu wa kpwandza wa Msikiti wa Chigato kula 1924 (tarehe za kuvyalwa na kufwa tazimanyikana)

meta.en: Role: Qur'an teacher and first Imam of the Chigato Mosque; one of the first generation of Digo imams in the Tiwi area
meta.sw: Jukumu: Mwalimu wa Qurani na Imamu wa kwanza wa Msikiti wa Chigato; mmoja wa kizazi cha kwanza cha maimamu wa Kidigo katika eneo la Tiwi
meta.dg: Kazi: Mwalimu wa Kuruani na Imamu wa kpwandza wa Msikiti wa Chigato; mmwenga wa maimamu a kpwandza a Chidigo kanda ya Tiwi

meta.en: Region: Chigato and Vuga, between Tiwi and Kwale, present-day Kenya
meta.sw: Eneo: Chigato na Vuga, kati ya Tiwi na Kwale, Kenya ya leo
meta.dg: Phatu: Chigato na Vuga, kahi ya Tiwi na Kwale, Kenya ya rero

blocks.en: In the 1920s the villages behind Tiwi changed quickly. Mosques went up one after another, and for the first time most of them were led by Digo imams who had been taught close to home. The historian David Sperling gave this change a heading of its own in his thesis: "The First Digo Imams". The first name under that heading is Kassim Mwachinyama of Chigato.
blocks.sw: Katika miaka ya 1920 vijiji vilivyo nyuma ya Tiwi vilibadilika haraka. Misikiti ilijengwa mmoja baada ya mwingine, na kwa mara ya kwanza mingi yake iliongozwa na maimamu Wadigo waliofundishwa karibu na nyumbani. Mwanahistoria David Sperling aliipa mabadiliko haya kichwa chake mwenyewe katika tasnifu yake: "Maimamu wa Kwanza wa Kidigo". Jina la kwanza chini ya kichwa hicho ni Kassim Mwachinyama wa Chigato.
blocks.dg: Kpwenye miaka ya 1920 vidzidzi vya nyuma ya Tiwi vyabadilika upesi. Misikiti yadzengbwa, msikiti mmwenga bada ya wanjina, na kpwa mara ya kpwandza minji kahi yao kala inalongozwa ni maimamu Adigo ariofundzwa phephi na kaya. Mwanahistoria David Sperling waandika seemu nzima kuhusu mabadiliko higa kpwenye tasnifuye, ichiihwa "Maimamu a Kpwandza a Chidigo". Dzina ra kpwandza kpwenye seemu iyo ni Kassim Mwachinyama wa Chigato.

blocks.en: What we know about him comes from a few paragraphs in Sperling's work. Sperling built them from interviews he recorded at Chigato, Chigongoni and Vuga in 1985 and 1986. This article keeps close to that account.
blocks.sw: Tunachokijua kumhusu kinatoka katika aya chache za kazi ya Sperling. Sperling aliziandika kutokana na mahojiano aliyorekodi Chigato, Chigongoni na Vuga mwaka 1985 na 1986. Makala haya yanafuata kwa karibu masimulizi hayo.
blocks.dg: Habari hunazozimanya kuhusu iye zinaphahikana kpwenye aya chache za kazi ya Sperling. Sperling wazihenda kula kpwa maswali ariyoauza atu iko Chigato, Chigongoni na Vuga mwaka 1985 na 1986, achigaandika majibu gao. Makala gano ganalunga habari izo phephi-phephi.

blocks.en: Islam in the Tiwi Hinterland
blocks.sw: Uislamu Nyuma ya Tiwi
blocks.dg: Uislamu Nyuma ya Tiwi

blocks.en: Islam had been growing in the Tiwi area for a generation before Kassim. Around 1894 a teacher named Juma Matungale, whose mother was a Digo from Chitsanga, settled at Tiwi. The Mkoyo Mosque was built there around 1898, with Matungale as its first Imam. By 1916, according to oral testimony, more than half of the elders of Tiwi's *ngambi*, the village council of elders, were Muslims.
blocks.sw: Uislamu ulikuwa ukikua katika eneo la Tiwi kwa kizazi kizima kabla ya Kassim. Karibu mwaka 1894 mwalimu aitwaye Juma Matungale, ambaye mama yake alikuwa Mdigo kutoka Chitsanga, alihamia Tiwi. Msikiti wa Mkoyo ulijengwa huko karibu mwaka 1898, na Matungale akawa Imamu wake wa kwanza. Kufikia mwaka 1916, kwa mujibu wa masimulizi ya mdomo, zaidi ya nusu ya wazee wa *ngambi* ya Tiwi, yaani baraza la wazee la kijiji, walikuwa Waislamu.
blocks.dg: Uislamu kala unakula kanda ya Tiwi kpwa muda mure kabla ya Kassim. Kama mwaka 1894 mwalimu mmwenga aihwaye Juma Matungale, ambaye nine kala ni Mdigo wa Chitsanga, wakpwedza kusagala Tiwi. Msikiti wa Mkoyo wadzengbwa iko kama mwaka 1898, na Matungale achikala Imamu wa kpwandza wa msikiti uho. Dza atu arivyosimulia, hadi mwaka 1916 zaidi ya nusu ya azehe a *ngambi* ya Tiwi, baraza ra azehe ra mudzi, kala ni Aislamu.

blocks.en: Further inland, around Chigato and Vuga, there were still few teachers. That changed with the arrival of Salimini bin Simba, a Yao from southern Tanzania who had come to Kenya as a soldier before the First World War. He married a woman from a Vuga family and settled there. In 1915 a District Commissioner found "a Swahili (ex KAR)" living at Vuga without permission and told him to go. Sperling thinks this was Salimini. That year Salimini moved to Chigongoni, became Imam of the Mabatani Mosque and opened a Qur'an school. Sperling calls him "the first teacher in the Chigato area". Around 1922 he helped build the Makunguni Mosque at Chigongoni and became its first Imam.
blocks.sw: Ndani zaidi, karibu na Chigato na Vuga, walimu walikuwa bado wachache. Hali hiyo ilibadilika alipofika Salimini bin Simba, Myao kutoka kusini mwa Tanzania aliyekuja Kenya akiwa askari kabla ya Vita vya Kwanza vya Dunia. Alimwoa mwanamke wa familia moja ya Vuga na akaishi huko. Mwaka 1915 Mkuu wa Wilaya alimkuta "Mswahili (aliyekuwa askari wa KAR)" akiishi Vuga bila ruhusa, akamwamuru aondoke. Sperling anadhani huyo alikuwa Salimini. Mwaka huo Salimini alihamia Chigongoni, akawa Imamu wa Msikiti wa Mabatani, na akafungua chuo cha Qurani. Sperling anamwita "mwalimu wa kwanza katika eneo la Chigato". Karibu mwaka 1922 alisaidia kujenga Msikiti wa Makunguni huko Chigongoni na akawa Imamu wake wa kwanza.
blocks.dg: Kure na pwani, phephi na Chigato na Vuga, alimu kala bado ni achache. Hali iyo yabadilika ariphofika Salimini bin Simba, Myao wa kusini ya Tanzania ariyekpwedza Kenya dza asikari kabla ya Vita vya Kpwandza vya Dunia. Walola mchetu wa mbari mwenga ya Vuga achisagala iko. Mwaka 1915 Afisa wa Wilaya wamuona "Mswahili (ariyekala asikari wa KAR)" anasagala Vuga bila ruhusa, achimuambira atsame. Sperling anaona kukala iye kala ni Salimini. Mwaka uho Salimini watsamira Chigongoni, achikala Imamu wa Msikiti wa Mabatani, na achivugula chuwo cha Kuruani. Sperling anamuiha "mwalimu wa kpwandza kanda ya Chigato". Kama mwaka 1922 waterya kudzenga Msikiti wa Makunguni iko Chigongoni, achikala Imamu wa kpwandza wa msikiti uho.

blocks.en: A Student of Salimini
blocks.sw: Mwanafunzi wa Salimini
blocks.dg: Mwanafundzi wa Salimini

blocks.en: Kassim Mwachinyama was one of Salimini's early students. His older brother, Hamisi Mwachinyama, was the head of Chigato village.
blocks.sw: Kassim Mwachinyama alikuwa mmoja wa wanafunzi wa mwanzo wa Salimini. Kaka yake mkubwa, Hamisi Mwachinyama, alikuwa mkuu wa kijiji cha Chigato.
blocks.dg: Kassim Mwachinyama kala ni mmwenga wa anafundzi a kpwandza a Salimini. Mvyerewe, Hamisi Mwachinyama, kala ni mkpwulu wa chidzidzi cha Chigato.

blocks.en: Salimini did more than teach his students to read the Qur'an. Sperling writes that he knew "the important role his students would play in their home villages", and trained some of them to lead prayers. Kassim is said to have practised giving the Friday sermon at the Makunguni Mosque under Salimini's guidance. A Qur'an teacher of this kind is called a *mwalimu* (teacher), and the step from pupil to teacher to imam is the path Kassim followed.
blocks.sw: Salimini hakuwafundisha wanafunzi wake kusoma Qurani tu. Sperling anaandika kwamba alijua "nafasi muhimu ambayo wanafunzi wake wangekuwa nayo katika vijiji vyao", na akawafunza baadhi yao kuongoza swala. Inasemekana Kassim alijizoeza kutoa hutuba ya Ijumaa katika Msikiti wa Makunguni chini ya uongozi wa Salimini. Mwalimu wa Qurani wa aina hii huitwa *mwalimu*, na hatua ya kutoka mwanafunzi hadi mwalimu hadi imamu ndiyo njia aliyoifuata Kassim.
blocks.dg: Salimini kala anaafundza anafundzie zaidi ya kusoma Kuruani. Sperling anaandika kukala kala anamanya "kazi muhimu ambayo anafundzie andahenda kpwenye vidzidzi vyao", achiafundza anjina kahi yao kulongoza swala. Nkugombwa kukala Kassim kala anadzizoeza kulavya hutuba ya Ijumaa kpwenye Msikiti wa Makunguni, Salimini achimlongoza. Mwalimu wa Kuruani wa aina ihi nkuihwa *mwalimu*, na hatua za kula mwanafundzi, kukala mwalimu, chisha imamu, ndiyo njira ariyoilunga Kassim.

blocks.en: The Chigato Mosque, 1924
blocks.sw: Msikiti wa Chigato, 1924
blocks.dg: Msikiti wa Chigato, 1924

blocks.en: In 1924, when Kassim was about to finish his studies, Hamisi decided to build a mosque at Chigato so that his brother could be its first Imam.
blocks.sw: Mwaka 1924, Kassim alipokuwa karibu kumaliza masomo yake, Hamisi aliamua kujenga msikiti Chigato ili ndugu yake awe Imamu wake wa kwanza.
blocks.dg: Mwaka 1924, Kassim ariphokala phephi kumala masomoge, Hamisi waamuwa kudzenga msikiti Chigato ili nduguye akale Imamu wa kpwandza wa msikiti uho.

blocks.en: This was a pattern in the area. Sperling describes "a friendly rivalry between villages that boasted an 'educated son' whom they sought to honour by building a mosque". The Mwamabanda Mosque (1926), the Mkunguni Mosque (1928) and the Chai Mosque (1929) were all built for young men who had just finished their studies. By 1930 there were eight mosques in the Tiwi area, and seven of them had Digo imams.
blocks.sw: Huu ulikuwa mtindo katika eneo hilo. Sperling anaeleza "ushindani wa kirafiki kati ya vijiji vilivyojivunia 'mwana msomi' waliyetaka kumheshimu kwa kumjengea msikiti". Msikiti wa Mwamabanda (1926), Msikiti wa Mkunguni (1928) na Msikiti wa Chai (1929) yote ilijengwa kwa ajili ya vijana waliokuwa wamemaliza masomo yao punde. Kufikia mwaka 1930 kulikuwa na misikiti minane katika eneo la Tiwi, na saba kati yake ilikuwa na maimamu Wadigo.
blocks.dg: Hiri kala ni dzambo ra kawaida kanda iyo. Sperling anagomba kpwa "upindzani wa chirafiki kahi ya vidzidzi virivyokala vinadzidai kukala na 'mwana ariyesoma', ambaye kala vinamendza kumuishimu kpwa kumdzengera msikiti". Msikiti wa Mwamabanda (1926), Msikiti wa Mkunguni (1928) na Msikiti wa Chai (1929) yosi yadzengbwa kpwa ajili ya barobaro ariokala ndipho akamala masomo gao. Hadi mwaka 1930 kala kuna misikiti minane kanda ya Tiwi, na sabaa kahi yao kala ina maimamu Adigo.

blocks.en: Teacher to Vuga
blocks.sw: Mwalimu wa Vuga
blocks.dg: Mwalimu wa Vuga

blocks.en: Kassim's influence reached beyond Chigato. Vuga, about three miles away, had a mosque from around 1922 but no Qur'an school and no local imam. Imams came from Tiwi to lead Friday prayers. Sometimes it was Salimini or Kassim, more often Sulayman Mwakuaza of Mkunguni. Children from Vuga walked to Chigato to study with Kassim.
blocks.sw: Ushawishi wa Kassim ulifika mbali zaidi ya Chigato. Vuga, umbali wa kama maili tatu, ilikuwa na msikiti tangu karibu mwaka 1922 lakini haikuwa na chuo cha Qurani wala imamu wa hapo. Maimamu walitoka Tiwi kuja kuongoza swala ya Ijumaa. Mara nyingine alikuwa Salimini au Kassim, lakini mara nyingi zaidi alikuwa Sulayman Mwakuaza wa Mkunguni. Watoto wa Vuga walitembea kwa miguu hadi Chigato kusoma kwa Kassim.
blocks.dg: Kazi ya Kassim yafika kure kuriko Chigato. Vuga, ambayo i kure kama maili tahu, kala ina msikiti tangu kama mwaka 1922, ela kala taina chuwo cha Kuruani wala imamu wa phapho. Maimamu kala anakpwedza kula Tiwi kulongoza swala ya Ijumaa. Wakati wanjina kala ni Salimini ama Kassim, ela mara nyinji kala ni Sulayman Mwakuaza wa Mkunguni. Ana a Vuga kala ananyendeka hadi Chigato kusoma kpwa Kassim.

blocks.en: Tsufu, the Muslim headman of Vuga who had led the building of its mosque, sent his sons to Kassim. He later persuaded Kassim to move to Vuga and teach them at home. When Tsufu's eldest son, Sulayman Zingizi, finished his studies, Kassim went back to Chigato. Zingizi became Imam of the Vuga Mosque and opened the village's own Qur'an school. In this way the teaching passed from Salimini to Kassim, and from Kassim to the next village.
blocks.sw: Tsufu, mkuu wa kijiji cha Vuga aliyekuwa Mwislamu na aliyeongoza ujenzi wa msikiti wake, aliwapeleka wanawe kwa Kassim. Baadaye alimshawishi Kassim ahamie Vuga awafundishe huko nyumbani. Mwanawe wa kwanza wa Tsufu, Sulayman Zingizi, alipomaliza masomo yake, Kassim alirudi Chigato. Zingizi akawa Imamu wa Msikiti wa Vuga na akafungua chuo cha Qurani cha kijiji chenyewe. Kwa njia hii elimu ilipita kutoka kwa Salimini hadi kwa Kassim, na kutoka kwa Kassim hadi kijiji kilichofuata.
blocks.dg: Tsufu, Dzumbe wa Vuga ariyekala Mwislamu na ariyelongoza kazi ya kudzenga msikiti wa phapho, wahuma anae a chilume kpwa Kassim. Badaye wamshawishi Kassim atsamire Vuga akaafundze iko kaya. Mwana wa kpwandza wa Tsufu, Sulayman Zingizi, ariphomala masomoge, Kassim wauya Chigato. Zingizi achikala Imamu wa Msikiti wa Vuga, na achivugula chuwo cha Kuruani phapho Vuga. Kpwa njira iyo mafundzo gatsapa kula kpwa Salimini kuphiya kpwa Kassim, na kula kpwa Kassim kuphiya chidzidzi chiricholunga.

blocks.en: Why the Record Is Thin
blocks.sw: Kwa Nini Habari Zake ni Chache
blocks.dg: Mbona Habarize ni Chache

blocks.en: Everything above rests on Sperling's thesis, which draws on a handful of oral informants. No colonial file that has been checked names Kassim. We do not know when he was born or died, how long he served as Imam, or whether he had children who carried on his work.
blocks.sw: Yote yaliyotajwa hapo juu yanategemea tasnifu ya Sperling, ambayo inatumia masimulizi ya watu wachache tu. Hakuna faili la kikoloni lililokaguliwa linalomtaja Kassim. Hatujui alizaliwa lini au alifariki lini, alihudumu kama Imamu kwa muda gani, wala kama alikuwa na watoto walioendeleza kazi yake.
blocks.dg: Gosi garigogombwa dzulu ganaphahikana kpwenye tasnifu ya Sperling bahi, nayo inahumira maneno ga atu achache. Takuna faili ra chikoloni ririrololwa ririrotaja dzina ra Kassim. Tahumanya ariphovyalwa wala ariphofwa, wala muda ariokala Imamu, wala kala ana ana ariolunga kaziye.

blocks.en: The chronology is also uneven. Sperling dates the Chigato Mosque to 1924, when Kassim was "about to finish" his studies. Yet he also says Tsufu moved Kassim to Vuga "shortly after the first World War", and that Vuga children were already studying with him before the Vuga Mosque was built around 1922. Both cannot be exact. Kassim may have been teaching younger pupils while still finishing his own studies, but the sources do not say.
blocks.sw: Mpangilio wa matukio pia haulingani. Sperling anaweka mwaka wa Msikiti wa Chigato kuwa 1924, wakati ambapo Kassim alikuwa "karibu kumaliza" masomo yake. Hata hivyo anasema pia kwamba Tsufu alimhamishia Kassim Vuga "muda mfupi baada ya Vita vya Kwanza vya Dunia", na kwamba watoto wa Vuga walikuwa tayari wakisoma kwake kabla Msikiti wa Vuga haujajengwa karibu mwaka 1922. Yote mawili hayawezi kuwa sahihi kabisa. Huenda Kassim alikuwa akifundisha wanafunzi wadogo huku bado akimaliza masomo yake mwenyewe, lakini vyanzo havisemi hivyo.
blocks.dg: Tarehe za mambo higa piya tazilingana. Sperling anaika Msikiti wa Chigato mwaka 1924, wakati Kassim kala "phephi kumala" masomoge. Ela piya anagomba kukala Tsufu wamtsamiza Kassim kuphiya Vuga "muda mfupi bada ya Vita vya Kpwandza vya Dunia", na kukala ana a Vuga kala tayari anasoma kpwakpwe kabla Msikiti wa Vuga kudzangbwedzengbwa kama mwaka 1922. Gosi mairi tagaweza kukala ni ga kpweli kamili. Chahi Kassim kala anafundza anafundzi adide kuno iye mwenye bado anamala masomoge, ela vyanzo tavigomba hivyo.

blocks.en: "First" also needs care. Sperling's heading refers to the Tiwi and Chigato area. Elsewhere, Digo imams came earlier: Mwalimu Ali bin Muhammad Mwaganyuma was the first Imam of the Pungu Mosque in the 1890s.
blocks.sw: Neno "wa kwanza" nalo linahitaji tahadhari. Kichwa cha Sperling kinahusu eneo la Tiwi na Chigato. Kwingineko maimamu Wadigo walitangulia: Mwalimu Ali bin Muhammad Mwaganyuma alikuwa Imamu wa kwanza wa Msikiti wa Pungu katika miaka ya 1890.
blocks.dg: Neno "wa kpwandza" piya rinalondwa kulolwa kpwa makini. Seemu ya Sperling inagomba kanda ya Tiwi na Chigato bahi. Kpwenye phatu phanjina maimamu Adigo akpwedza kare zaidi: Mwalimu Ali bin Muhammad Mwaganyuma kala ni Imamu wa kpwandza wa Msikiti wa Pungu kpwenye miaka ya 1890.

blocks.en: Legacy
blocks.sw: Urithi Wake
blocks.dg: Urisiwe

blocks.en: Kassim Mwachinyama left no writings that we know of. What he left was a role. He was one of the first young men of the Tiwi hinterland to be trained at home and then to lead his own village in prayer. Through his pupils at Chigato and Vuga, Qur'an teaching spread to places that had none. The Chigato Mosque, built for him by his brother in 1924, marks the moment when the Digo of this area began to take over the leadership of their own mosques.
blocks.sw: Kassim Mwachinyama hakuacha maandishi yoyote tunayoyajua. Alichoacha ni nafasi. Alikuwa mmoja wa vijana wa kwanza wa eneo lililo nyuma ya Tiwi kufundishwa nyumbani kisha kuongoza kijiji chake mwenyewe katika swala. Kupitia wanafunzi wake wa Chigato na Vuga, mafundisho ya Qurani yalienea hadi mahali ambapo hapakuwa nayo. Msikiti wa Chigato, aliojengewa na kaka yake mwaka 1924, unaashiria wakati Wadigo wa eneo hili walipoanza kushika uongozi wa misikiti yao wenyewe.
blocks.dg: Tahumanya maandiko gogosi ariyogaricha Kassim Mwachinyama. Ela waricha njira. Kala ni mmwenga wa barobaro a kpwandza a kanda ya nyuma ya Tiwi kufundzwa phephi na kaya, chisha kulongoza atu a chidzidziche swala. Kpwa njira ya anafundzie a Chigato na Vuga, mafundzo ga Kuruani gaenea hadi phatu ambapho kala takuna. Msikiti wa Chigato, ambao mvyerewe wamdzengera mwaka 1924, unaonyesa wakati Adigo a kanda iyo ariphoandza kuhala uongozi wa misikiti yao.
